correctness.rationale: For each undirected simple graph, antitone open NOR satisfies F³=F by symmetric open-neighborhood incidence. Its empty/full two-cycle basin is 1 plus total dominating sets. The auxiliary diagonal-edge graph turns each open-neighbor condition into a closed-neighborhood dominating condition on C_{2n} or two C_n, with parity interchanged by the Möbius seam. The 4-state no-000 cyclic transfer has exact characteristic polynomial X(X³−X²−X−1). The pairwise root products give the cubic Q and exact seam difference. Irreducibility and discriminant −44 give S3 splitting field and exclude cyclotomic conjugate-root ratio, yielding irrational angle and infinitely many sign changes in every residue class. Odd recurrence values prove nonvanishing. Independent exhaustive 2^2n configuration checks on each graph n=3..9 and integer transfer calculations n=3..40 pass; all-size conclusions rest on proof.

value.rationale: The two classic degree-3, equal-size ladder graph families differ only by a seam, making topology sensitivity of a concrete dynamical attraction population a natural exact question. The result identifies every initial state attracted to an intrinsic universal 2-cycle and supplies an all-size nonzero difference and an unexpected aperiodic sign reversal in every arithmetic progression, rather than just a routine finite count. The earlier ordinary-prism total-domination formula is credited and not presented as novel; the substantive comparison and irrational-angle sign law are motivated, structural and not found in relevant indexed prior records.
